reasoning_content: Now let me add and commit the App.js changes:

action.command:
cd /workspace && git add App.js && git commit -m "fix: prevent event duplication when scrolling with stockholm filter

Root cause:
- loadEvents appended new data to state without deduplication
- handleLoadMore triggered on scroll even when provider filter was active
- No stable keys used in SectionList for React list reconciliation

Changes:
- Added deduplicateEvents() function using stable keys (id or title+start_time)
- Added isFetchingRef to prevent concurrent fetches
- Updated handleLoadMore to block pagination when ANY filter is active
- Improved keyExtractor to use stable event.id or composite keys
- Fixed GroupedEventItem keys for consistent list rendering

This ensures:
- Each event appears exactly once in the list
- No duplicate fetches on scroll
- Stable React list rendering with proper key reconciliation
- Works correctly with all filters (stockholm, time, category)"
